# Closed sources

Six closed rows for the proposal screener: two closed on reach, four on a measurement, and
one of the reach rows also measured, so both classes and the mixed case are present.

| source | date | measured | reason | link |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IRCache / NLANR proxy traces | 2026-08-06 | not priced | CLOSED. Gone: ircache.net serves a squatted blog and the trace FTP host is dead. | ircache.net ircache.nlanr.net |
| GeoCities, Tripod and Angelfire member indexes | 2026-08-08 | 0 EE | CLOSED. Every member URL sits under a provider domain, and 97.4% of the rest is already held. | <https://www.oocities.org/> |
| SEC EDGAR filings 1996-2001 | 2026-08-08 | 1.9 EE | CLOSED. 150 filings across six years gave 4 net-new pairs. | <https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/full-index/> |
| Common Crawl | 2026-08-06 | not priced | CLOSED. The earliest collection is 2008-05, out of window. | <https://commoncrawl.org/> |
| webbase_crawl_lists / dated_list | 2026-09-23 | 0 EE | CLOSED. Files are named MMYY and every one dates 2003 to 2006. | <https://web.archive.org/web/20060527013341/http://dbpubs.stanford.edu:8091/~testbed/doc2/WebBase/crawl_lists/> dbpubs.stanford.edu |
| Printed Internet directory books, the whole named family | 2026-08-08 | not priced | CLOSED on reach and on yield: the scanned text files return HTTP 401, and the HathiTrust route would not have paid, measured at 15.7 net-new pairs per volume. | <https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php> |
